 Hon'Ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal, J. 
1. Heard Sri Ashutosh Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant and learned Aga for the
State.
2.

By means of present application, the applicant is seeking prayer to release on bail in added sections i.e. Sections 409 and 120B IPC in Case Crime No.548 of 2023, Police Station Gola, District Gorakhpur, wherein this Court has already granted bail to the applicant in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14362 of 2025 vide order dated 14.07.2025.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 14362 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the applicant has already been granted bail in Case Crime No.548 of 2023, under Sections 420, 406, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Gola,
District Gorakhpur after considering the entire material available on record.
Merely because Sections 409 and 120 B IPC have been added, the applicant cannot be kept behind the bar.
It is submitted that the applicant is a lady of 68 years old and she has made escape goat by the Branch Manager of the concerned Bank, therefore, she is entitled to be released on bail.
4. Learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

5. Thus, considering the entire facts and circumstances of the case, submissions of learned counsel for the parties and keeping in view the nature of offence, evidence, complicity of accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the opinion that the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.

6. Let the applicant- Moti Devi involved in the aforementioned crime be released on bail, on his furnishing a personal bond and sureties given in pursuance of bail order dated 14.07.2025 passed in Criminal Misc Bail Application No.14362 of 2025 shall remain good in the present bail application,
with the following conditions:-
i.

entities.text: Criminal Misc Bail Application No.14362 of 2025
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial/investigation sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
iv. The applicant shall attend in accordance with the conditions of the bond executed by him.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
